_what: Post-lean COST snapshot for FAFF-970 (kernel leaning, PR #821). Dollar companion to post-lean-snapshot-20260902.json (which carried only per-lane prefixes, no $). Reprices the SAME pinned reference run per-lane at the post-lean resident prefixes and reconciles against the post-split blend.
source_run: evidence/cost-run-20260829-100405 (full L4 lights-out build, 843 calls, 19 transcripts) — the same run the pre-split and post-split baselines were captured on
method: Real per-file tokenomics pass. Each of the 19 transcripts is classified into its lane by its opening instruction (see per_file_classification), then priced with `node eval/tokenomics.mjs --transcript <file> --fixed 66165 --lean <post-lean lane prefix> --json` (bench[0]=baseline @ 66,165, bench[1]=post-lean). The SAME files repriced at the post-split prefixes reconstruct the pinned figures — reconstructed baseline $132.91 (pinned $132.913) and post-split $128.28 (pinned $128.29) — validating the classification. Per-lane resident prefix re-measured on merged main = kernel.md (23,364 tok) + estimateTokens() of each lane reference the skill's load-line declares it Reads (negated 'never Reads' clauses and 'see the sibling' pointers excluded; only wtf/map affected, by the autonomous.md pointer).
compares_to: eval/baselines/post-split-snapshot-20260902.json (post_split blended $128.29, kernel 28,634 tok) and pre-split-snapshot-20260901.json (pinned baseline $132.913, gateway 66,165 tok)

per_lane_prefixes_post_lean._note: measured post-lean resident gateway prefix per skill = kernel (23,364) + the lane references that skill Reads; wtf/map exclude autonomous.md (declared never-read).

per_lane_prefix_delta_vs_split._note: post-lean minus post-split resident prefix. The split is asymmetric by design: heavy build lanes shed only Ticket templates (moved to create.md, which they do not Read); Control-label/Calibration/Park moved into references those lanes still Read, so they are neutral there. Interactive + light lanes, which Read none of autonomous/methodology/park, shed the full ~4.4-5.3k.

per_lane_cost.note: heavy-blend prefix; prep/graft/tidy not individually separable in these four, all shed only Ticket templates
dark spec-review; reads kernel + methodology only, sheds the full Ticket-templates + Control-label + Park
gateway not a cost driver for this transcript; prefix drops 5,270 but dollar impact ~0

per_file_classification._note: Each transcript classified by its opening instruction. Validated: repricing these at the post-split prefixes reconstructs $132.91 baseline / $128.28 post-split.

findings: FAFF-970 adds -$0.85 (-0.66%) on this build-dominated L4 run; cumulative -4.1% from the pinned baseline.

Small here by design: the lanes that dominate the bill (beep-boop, graft, prep/tidy) shed only Ticket templates (~1,511 tok) because Control-label -> autonomous.md, Calibration -> methodology.md, and Park -> park.md all landed in references those heavy lanes still Read.
Where FAFF-970 actually lifts hard: interactive wtf/map entry (-4,386 tok/call) and the light lanes onboard/evaluate (-5,270 tok/call) — none well-represented on a build transcript.

Confirms the FAFF-607 prediction: the dollar prize needs read-heavy interactive workloads this build run does not represent; on build-dominated runs the win is per-call prefix (measured, real) more than blended dollars (small).
caveats: Real per-file tokenomics pass, not an interpolation; reconstructed baseline $132.91 and post-split $128.28 reconcile with the pinned $132.913 / $128.29, validating the lane classification. The 'autonomous prep/graft/tidy (heavy)' lane keeps the snapshot's single blended prefix (prep/graft/tidy not individually separable in those 4 transcripts); post-lean shifts it by -1,511 (Ticket templates), the shed common to all three heavy lanes.
Per-lane prefixes measured with eval/cli-driver.mjs estimateTokens (chars/4), the same estimator eval/prefix-planner.mjs uses; wtf/map corrected for the never-read autonomous.md pointer.
repro: Classify each transcript by opening instruction (see per_file_classification), then `node eval/tokenomics.mjs --transcript <file> --fixed 66165 --lean <post-lean lane prefix> --json` and sum bench[1].cost per lane. Structure: `node eval/prefix-planner.mjs` (kernel 23,364 / tax 19,339 / floor 15,293).
related: FAFF-970 (this lean, PR #821), FAFF-607 (the split, PR #819), FAFF-487 (prose-lean remainder), FAFF-971 (loader decouple)
